entry.title: New: Bill 28, CD1, FD1 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING ORDINANCE NO. 4998 (2019) RELATING TO THE CHANGE IN ZONING (CONDITIONAL ZONING) TO WAIKAPU COUNTRY TOWN (WCT) DISTRICT FOR PROPERTY SITUATED AT WAILUKU, MAUI, HAWAII" The propose of this bill is to amend Ordinance No. 4998 to allow: 1) additional residential workforce housing units to be provided in lieu of fulfilling certain change in zoning conditions; and 2) deed-restriction periods to be set for residential workforce housing units in Waikapu Country Town.
